- Material/property values differ across sections: tissue k=0.53 vs 0.47 W/m·K; blood viscosity 3.5 vs 3.2 mPa·s (input properties inconsistency).

- Configuration control note: mesh growth-rate tweak not in version control despite claim of scripted, tracked runs (QA/process inconsistency).
